newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends flat on intervention fears.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends flat on intervention fears.

text.p: The won closed flat versus the dollar on Friday as fears of a central bank intervention prevented banks from selling dollars, traders said.
The won finished at 887.20. It opened at 886.90 and moved in a range of 886.80 to 887.40.
"The 887 won level was supported by repeated rumours of interventions," said a trader at Korea First Bank.
In absence of intervention woes, the won would have rallied on the back of inflow of foreign funds for equity investment and improving trade account, traders said.
Traders said the won was expected to move in a range of 887.00 to 888.00 on Monday with a base mid-rate at 887.10-887.20. Today's mid-rate was pegged at 887.20.
